page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a running head and page number at the top. No marginal notes. Below the text there is only faint show-through and blotches, which are left out.

main_text.p: 2. εἶμι eo, forma præsentis, significatione futuri, pro ibo, apud oratores; apud poetas, aliquando præsentis.
Singularis 2. etiam εἶ, unde ἀπὸ abis, ἐξὶ exis, prodis. Est etiam per reduplicationem ἴημι, unde ἵησι vadit.
.Præf. 3. εἴω, εἴης, irem, ires: sed feré obsoletum.
ἴμεν, ἴτε, ἴσαν. Item ὦ, ἧς, ἦ, unde παρελθῶ adveniebam.

page.notes: Faint and blurred Greek accents and breathings in several places (e.g. ἴμεν, ἴτλω, παρελθῶ) are doubtful and have not been marked individually. The scan is faded at the right edge and in the lower half, but no lines are lost there.
